_comment: Example custom POI set for the Maah Daah Hey 100 race-day mockup. Loaded into the embedded map via embed.js data-pois. Same fields and coordinate space as the default pois.json.

pois.title: Race Registration
pois.description: Check in here on race morning to grab your bib, timing chip, and packet before the start. Day-of registration and last-minute questions are handled at this tent — arrive early and give yourself time to roll to the start line.

pois.title: Finish Line
pois.description: The finish, where up to 107 miles of Maah Daah Hey singletrack finally come to an end. Cheer riders across the line, grab a photo under the banner, and soak in the relief and the Badlands views.

pois.title: Medal Ceremony
pois.description: Awards and finisher medals for every distance are handed out here after the race. Gather to celebrate every finisher, cheer on the podium, and trade trail stories from the day.

pois.title: Store
pois.description: The race store — jerseys, caps, and Maah Daah Hey 100 gear to remember the ride. Stop in before the start or after you cross the line.

pois.title: Beverage Sales
pois.description: Food and cold drinks to refuel between the action, with a place to sit and watch the trail. A welcome stop for riders and spectators alike.
